source_limitations: Small synthetic contract/behavior dataset; not a general model-quality score.
No retrieval, embedding, database, or complete agent workflow is measured.
No tools execute; selected read-only calls are validated only.
Successful latency excludes failed requests; throughput includes phase wall time.
Completion throughput includes reported reasoning tokens when the provider counts them.
Model IDs are request labels, not independent verification of served weights.
No streaming is used, so TTFT and decoder-only tokens/second are not measured.
Deployment metadata is operator supplied; it does not attest which weights the HTTP server loaded.
Quantized deployment results do not establish native-checkpoint or hosted-service equivalence.
Client concurrency above declared server_parallel_slots includes queueing, not parallel decoding.

memory.scope: Shared processes sampled after both benchmark paths; VmHWM is lifetime process high water and VmRSS is a point observation. No per-path or per-concurrency attribution; child peak is not aggregate memory.

limitations: Six synthetic contract cases, five repeats per case/concurrency; not a general model-quality benchmark.
p95 uses only 30 attempted or 25 validated samples in each measured phase; no confidence interval or significance claim.
Direct then gateway paths run sequentially; timing differences may reflect load, order and runtime state.
One server slot: client concurrency 2/4 includes server queueing and does not establish parallel decoding.
All-attempted latency retains behavioral failures; passed-only metrics condition on successful validation and may be biased.
Non-streaming elapsed request/phase timings include prompt processing, generation, transport and validation; no TTFT or decoder-only token rate.
Zero cached_prompt_tokens requires explicit zero usage in every sample; this does not prove all hardware/runtime caches are absent.
Raw benchmark does not measure retrieval, embeddings, database latency or complete agent workflow throughput.
Descriptive failed-run evidence only: no speedup, gateway performance gain, native-weight equivalence or production-readiness conclusion.
